numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses decreased by SEK 6.3 million compared to the previous year, totaling SEK 52.4 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: SEK 6.3 million decrease to SEK 52.4 million
numerical_claims.label: INCORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Operating expenses: SEK 52.4 million (57.3 million) - decrease of SEK 4.9 million. Organizational/R&D costs decreased by SEK 6.3 million.
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Operating expenses totaled MSEK 52.4 (57.3)'. Also: 'Organizational and R&D costs have decreased by MSEK 6.3 since the previous year.' Candidate incorrectly attributes the 6.3M decrease to total operating expenses.
numerical_claims.error_explanation: The candidate misstates the magnitude and scope of the operating expense reduction. Total operating expenses decreased by SEK 4.9M (from 57.3M to 52.4M), while the 6.3M reduction applies specifically to organizational and R&D costs - a subset of operating expenses.

numerical_claims.claim: Structural changes reduced overhead costs by SEK 5 million and lowered depreciation on development projects.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO letter: 'these changes... helped to reduce overhead costs in 2025 by SEK 5 million and reduced depreciation on development projects.'

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group's operating profit amounted to MSEK -1.9 (-9.7). EBITDA for the year was MSEK -1.7 (-2.1).'
